title: Passive and extension-like verb surfaces
source_locator: Fortune, George. (1955). An Analytical Grammar of Shona. Chapter VII: The Verb, Section 453: The Verbal Extensions (pp. 201-222).
rule_summary: Extraction of passive (-w- / -ew- / -iw-), causative (-is- / -es-), and applicative (-ir- / -er-) verb stem extensions under vowel harmony height rules.

examples.note: Causative extension under high vowel harmony.
Applicative extension under high vowel harmony.
Causative extension under mid vowel harmony.

notes: This card authorizes generated and analyzed passive, causative, and applicative forms under height harmony.

qa.reviewer_notes: Validated passive, causative, and applicative extensions under standard height harmony rules.

api_safety.backward_compatibility: Adds support for verbal extensions in the analyzer and generator.
